summary: Phase 2 testing (buyer checkout + account). Backend: 10/10 pytest tests PASS (coupons, OTP, addresses CRUD, orders with seller_id, TM short_id, buyer-403 status guard). Frontend: unauthenticated guards work, OTP signup works, cart+coupon apply/remove works, checkout stepper Address→Payment→Review works, order is CREATED (POST /api/orders returns 200). CRITICAL BUG: after order placement, user is redirected to empty /cart instead of /order/success/{id}, so Order Confirmation and post-order tracking cannot be reached via the UI.

ui_bugs.issue: After successful POST /api/orders (200), UI navigates to /cart instead of /order/success/{id}. Order is stored in DB but the confirmation screen, order-id, order-eta, track-order-btn and order-tracker are never reachable via the UI. GET /api/orders/{id} is never even fired.
Spec asked for data-testid `account-nav-orders` but code produces `account-nav-my-orders` (label 'My Orders' -> lower-kebab). Sidebar link works, just naming drift.
Uses data-testid `new-address-btn` (not `add-address-btn` used on CheckoutPage). Inconsistent naming for the same action across pages.

integration_issues.flow: Place order -> Order confirmation -> Track order
integration_issues.issue: Blocked by the checkout redirect bug above. Order Confirmation page (/order/success/:id), order-id, order-eta, track-order-btn, order-tracker with 4 steps and seller-group-{seller_id} could NOT be verified via UI because navigation never reaches that page. Backend data supports these (short_id starts with 'TM', items have seller_id, status='placed', /api/orders/{id} enriches item.seller).

rca_of_the_issue: In /app/frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.jsx (place()), the sequence is: await api.post('/orders', ...); clear(); sessionStorage.removeItem(...); nav(`/order/success/${data.id}`, {replace:true}). Because React 18 batches these updates, `clear()` sets cart items to [] and `nav()` sets router state in the same batch. During the same render pass CheckoutPage still mounts (URL transition in-flight) and its top-level guard `if (items.length === 0) return <Navigate to='/cart' replace />` executes with the new empty cart, which redirects to /cart, overriding the imperative nav to /order/success/{id}. FIX (any of): (a) call nav() BEFORE clear(); (b) gate the empty-cart guard with a `placing` / `placed` flag so it doesn't fire while the order is being placed/redirected; (c) navigate with a small setTimeout(0) or React's flushSync around nav to force a router commit before state clear; (d) delay `clear()` to after navigation (e.g., in a useEffect on the confirmation page). Simplest fix: swap the two lines so nav happens before clear.
